purpose: C.9 Example 3 (points card with shared accelerated cap): per_unit rounding (floor_per_txn), stacks_with_base (portal_bonus adds on top of base, not instead of it), and a monthly reward-measure cap scoped to a rule_group (cap_portal only sums portal_bonus's reward, leaving base's reward on the same spend uncapped), plus the travel_portal redemption route's non-1.0 friction default.

assumptions.note: Both categories' ticket sizes are exact multiples of the Rs150 per_unit divisor (hotels_domestic 9000/150=60, dining 600/150=4), so floor(ticket/U) loses no remainder and the category-mode effective rate equals the true continuous rate exactly -- zero floor loss, no rounding_estimated flag expected anywhere.

_hand_computation: Stage 3 (match): hotels_domestic spend carries merchant_group=synth_portal, so it matches BOTH base (selector={}) and portal_bonus (merchant_groups=[synth_portal], stacks_with_base=true, rule_group=portal_accel) -- base binds as the non-stacking winner, portal_bonus binds alongside it. Dining spend has no merchant_group -> matches only base.

Stage 4 (accrue), per month: hotels_domestic Rs1,50,000/month, ticket Rs9,000. ea_base = floor(9000/150)*5/9000 = 60*5/9000 = 1/30 exact -> base reward = 1,50,000/30 = 5,000.00 pts. ea_bonus = 60*20/9000 = 2/15 exact -> portal_bonus reward (uncapped) = 1,50,000*2/15 = 20,000.00 pts.
dining Rs30,000/month, ticket Rs600. ea_base = floor(600/150)*5/600 = 4*5/600 = 1/30 exact -> base reward = 30,000/30 = 1,000.00 pts.

Stage 5 (cap): cap_portal = 15,000 bonus pts/calendar_month, scope=rule_group:portal_accel, overflow=zero. Only portal_bonus belongs to that rule_group (base has no rule_group), so the cap sums portal_bonus's reward alone: 20,000 > 15,000 every month -> capped to 15,000/month, the 5,000/month excess simply discarded. base's 5,000/month (same hotels_domestic spend) is untouched by this cap -- it isn't in the rule_group at all.

Stage 8 (valuation): declared primary route 'portal' (travel_portal, ratio 0.50, friction_default 0.9, no per_point_fee) -> per-point value = 0.50*0.9 = Rs0.45. gross_reward_value = 2,52,000 * 0.45 = Rs1,13,400.00.
Stage 6-7 (waiver): no exclusions on this card -> waiver-eligible spend = all spend = 18,00,000 + 3,60,000 = Rs21,60,000 >= Rs3,00,000 threshold -> fee waived (fee='annual' only).

Fees: joining_fee=Rs2,500, annual_fee=Rs2,500. Waived -> charged_annual=0 -> steady_fee = 0*1.18 = Rs0.00. year1_fee = (2,500+0)*1.18 = Rs2,950.00 (joining fee is never waived by this payload, only the annual fee is).
